query.value: @if(empty(activity('GetDistinctClientCodes').output.firstRow.ClientCodes), '<fetch><entity name="contact"><attribute name="contactid"/><attribute name="new_clientid"/><filter><condition attribute="new_clientid" operator="eq" value="00000000"/></filter></entity></fetch>', concat('<fetch><entity name="contact"><attribute name="contactid"/><attribute name="new_clientid"/><filter type="and"><condition attribute="new_clientid" operator="in">', concat('<value>', replace(activity('GetDistinctClientCodes').output.firstRow.ClientCodes, ',', '</value><value>'), '</value>'), '</condition></filter></entity></fetch>'))
